title: Your first minutes
summary: A look around the screen: what each part of the HUD tells you and where to start.
text:
You are the colony's caretaker AI. The probe has landed: the **Command Core** is your base, the worker drones build for you, and the **cryo bank** inside the Core holds the embryos of everyone who will ever live here.

Your first job is simple: keep the cryo bank powered, mine alloys and build. The GOALS panel always says what to do next.

- **Build** opens the build menu: start with a Solar Array, then Mining Depots by the glowing alloy deposits
- Tap a drone, a unit or a building to see what it is doing
- Packs of predators come before long, mostly from the edges: have a turret ready

Tap **Show me around** at the top of the Field Guide to see this tour again.

tour.text: GOALS: what to do next. Each objective ticks off as you do it, and the next mission follows.
Build: pick a building and place it near the Command Core. Your drones fly out and build it.
Alloys (◆) pay for everything. Mining Depots by the glowing deposits bring them in.
Power (⚡): what you make against what you want. Solar works by day only.
The battery (🔋) carries the colony through the night. Build one before dark.
The cryo bank (❄): the embryos. It needs power above all: if its integrity falls below half, embryos die.
The clock: a sol lasts six minutes, half of it night. Nights are dark, and the packs come bigger.
Threat (⚠): predators on the map. With a Radar, it also counts down to the next pack.
The radar map: tap or drag it to look somewhere. It needs a powered Radar.
The log: what just happened. Tap a line with ◎ to look at it.
Pause and fast forward. Space pauses too, and you can still give orders while paused.
The menu: save, options, Controls and this Field Guide. That's it: good luck, caretaker.
